# Map signatures, Maps 0-20 (2026-11-08, DES1)

**Design analysis, suggestions only: nothing here is applied.** Generated by `tools/des1/map_signatures_2026_11_08.py` (data: `map-signatures-2026-11-08.json`). The engine and `canonical/cards.json` win over this page.

Owner, 2026-11-08 09:27: *"in each map, 2-3 new unique signifying skills (may be 1-2 in Map 10+), and then a smattering of unimportant skills ... And they also have basics like guardians, arrow users, and quick-attackers."* New skills count on the main road only; side maps 0-1 (rarely 2).

New = skills no earlier main-road list carries (side maps: none earlier at all). Basics: **G** guardians, **R** ranged (shooters), **Q** quick attackers; ✓ 2+ cards, ½ one card, ✗ none. Proposed counts are signatures + kept minors.

## Flags

- **Over the new-skill limit:** 26 of 34 maps. Worst: Thistlewood 11, Sable Swampmire 9, The Morel Hollow 8, The Long Grass 8, Wolfsbane Tundra 8, Gannet Cliffs 7.
- **No clear signature (no new skill on 2+ cards):** Bramblewood Outskirts, Gannet Cliffs, Sunken Hollow, Gatorback Swamp, Sable Swampmire, The Morel Hollow, Caves & Alcoves, The Kelp Mangroves, Eyrie Heights, The Briar Maze, The Redwood Deep, Savanna Reaches, The Long Grass, The Pinewood Taiga, Wolfsbane Tundra, The Glass Dunes, Ashen Spurn.
- **No guardian:** 3 main maps (Tutorial, Wolfsbane Tundra, Ashen Spurn), 2 side maps.
- **No ranged unit:** 14 main maps (Bramblewood Outskirts, Thistlewood, Pebble Beach, Gannet Cliffs, Sunken Hollow, Gatorback Swamp, Sable Swampmire, The Morel Hollow, Caves & Alcoves, The Kelp Mangroves, Coral Current, The Briar Maze, The Redwood Deep, The Pinewood Taiga), 7 side maps.
- **No quick attacker:** 10 main maps (Pebble Beach, Sunken Hollow, Sable Swampmire, The Morel Hollow, The Kelp Mangroves, The Briar Maze, The Redwood Deep, The Pinewood Taiga, Wolfsbane Tundra, Ashen Spurn), 4 side maps.
- **One card per new skill is the norm.** 17 of 21 main maps have no new skill on 2+ of their cards, so no map has a strategy the player can see yet. The fix is mostly adding 1-2 carriers per signature, not new skills.
- **Ranged is missing on Maps 0-10:** no main map before Eyrie Heights (Map 11) has a single shooter on its list. Nine out-of-play shooters (Arrow, Spark, Bola) fit those maps by animal, plus the new Reach spear card (the bench is in the JSON).
- **The Tutorial shows 15 skills,** Dynamite, Landslide, Spiteful and Venomous among them: they belong to later maps.
- **Side maps pre-teach main skills:** Rage, Web, Bulldoze, Herbalist, Ambush, Mighty appear on a side map before the main map that should own them.

## How it was counted

- A map's cards: its list in `canonical/map-pools.json` (a side map: its whole submap list). "Own" = first list it is on.
- Skills: every skill on a card, base or any level (`levelSkills`), one per family (ENG35). Custom triggers (On X: do Y) are listed apart and not counted.
- Guardians: guardian, taunt, bulwark, fortification, rampart. Ranged: the single shots and ranged swings of `canonical/skill-delivery.json` (arrows, bolts, spits, Snipe, Reach, Boomerang ...); area and On Ready blasts are noted, not counted. Quick: Quick, Blitz, Haste, Speed N (swing order in the engine) and Pounce (strikes on landing).
